_doc: Canonical ingredient alias registry (distributor-tie P2). Maps generic culinary synonyms / standard variety names to one Cost Index ingredient key, so the same item under a different distributor label collapses to one tracked read. Gated by scripts/check-ingredient-aliases.mjs: every canonical key must be a real Cost Index key; every alias stem must already be in extractStem() canonical form (tools/_shared/stem.js); no stem may shadow a different tracked key, and no stem may map to two ingredients. verified:false = a staged alias not yet confirmed against a real distributor catalog (same fact-gate regime as staged price sources) — it ships only when flipped true. We seed ONLY general-knowledge synonyms/variety names here; brand SKUs (Calrose/Nishiki/etc.) require a sourced catalog before they enter.

cilantro.note: Same plant (Coriandrum sativum); distributors often label the fresh leaf 'coriander' or 'Chinese parsley'.

green-onion.note: Standard synonyms for the immature onion sold in bunches.

eggplant.note: British/Commonwealth name for the same vegetable.

zucchini.note: British/French name for the same summer squash.

bell-pepper.note: Commonwealth 'capsicum' / generic 'sweet pepper' for the same fruit.

romaine-lettuce.note: Romaine is sold as 'cos' lettuce in many catalogs.

butter-lettuce.note: Butterhead family; Bibb and Boston are the two common market types.

napa-cabbage.note: Napa is the common US name for Chinese (wong bok) cabbage.

bok-choy.note: Spelling/label variants for the same brassica.

daikon.note: Standard alternate names for the long white radish.

rutabaga.note: Commonwealth name for the same root.

snow-peas.note: Flat edible-pod pea, sold under these labels.

green-beans.note: Common market synonyms for the same bean.

cantaloupe.note: Regional names for the netted-rind melon.

shrimp.note: Generic synonym; collapses bare 'prawn' to the base shrimp read (head-on / P&D variants stay their own keys).
